description: This script manages DHCP client operations for LAN connectivity, including starting, stopping, renewing DHCP leases, and handling DHCP events such as deconfig, bound, and renew. It interacts with system events and network configurations to establish and maintain LAN DHCP connectivity.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes DHCP client settings, retrieves hostname and options, and logs the initialization.

methods.name: do_stop_dhcp
methods.description: Stops the DHCP client process and cleans up related files and logs.

methods.name: do_start_dhcp
methods.description: Starts the DHCP client process if not already running, setting necessary parameters.

methods.name: do_release_dhcp
methods.description: Releases the DHCP lease, stops the DHCP client, and updates system events.

methods.name: do_renew_dhcp
methods.description: Renews the DHCP lease by signaling the DHCP client process.
